hotels.title: Napa Valley Wine Country Escape with Daily Breakfast, Dining Credit & Wine Tasting
hotels.description: Experience the ultimate Napa Valley retreat at the Napa Valley Marriott Hotel & Spa, perfectly situated in the heart of California’s famed wine country. This upscale property offers the ideal blend of relaxation and adventure, with easy access to world-renowned vineyards, gourmet dining and charming local boutiques. Spend your days exploring the picturesque vineyards and return to the hotel for an evening of indulgence with exclusive on-site wine tastings. Unwind in style with the hotel’s luxurious amenities, including a serene outdoor pool, a rejuvenating spa and inviting fire pits perfect for relaxing under the Napa sky. Be sure to visit the property's onsite restaurant, Little Summer - a delightful setting for a delicious dinner, fed by locally-grown, seasonal ingredients from the chef’s own Heirloom Garden.
